say:1:1441118001:1.text: Guarding the secrets underground... General, is that your way of protecting Sal'thorin?
say:1:1441118001:1.source_cn: 在地底守卫不可告人的秘密……将军，这就是你对萨洛克兰的...

say:2:1441118002:0.text: The people have the right to the truth! A great kingdom shouldn't be built upon dirty secrets!
say:2:1441118002:0.source_cn: 萨洛克兰的人们需要知道真相，伟大的王国不应该建立在肮脏...

say:3:1441118003:0.text: It doesn't matter what our kingdom is built upon.
say:3:1441118003:0.source_cn: 我们伟大的王国，建立在什么上并不重要。

say:4:1441118004:0.text: Most importantly, we must keep the roots of our kingdom stable, or its trunk, leaves, and fruits will all wither away.
say:4:1441118004:0.source_cn: 你只需要知道，一旦动摇它的根基，它的枝干、树叶、果实都...

say:5:1441118005:0.text: All, be it the commoners, nobles, or priests, can't survive without the Queen's grace.
say:5:1441118005:0.source_cn: 无论平民，贵族，祭司，失去女王的恩典，都无法存活。

say:6:1441118006:1.text: Indris, your life and everything in your past have been built upon this filth as well.
say:6:1441118006:1.source_cn: 因度厄，你的生命，你过往的一切也都建立在这肮脏之上。

choice_prompt:7:1441118006.text: Indris, your life and everything in your past have been built upon this filth as well.
choice_prompt:7:1441118006.source_cn: 因度厄，你的生命，你过往的一切也都建立在这肮脏之上。

say:8:1441118007:0.text: If I knew the truth, I probably wouldn't...
say:8:1441118007:0.source_cn: 如果我知道真相，或许不会……

say:9:1441118008:1.text: You'd still drink the dew anyway.
say:9:1441118008:1.source_cn: 即便知道真相，你还是会喝下女王的恩典。

say:10:1441118009:1.text: Everyone in Sal'thorin is the same—even though we know the truth, we don't have any other choice. Ignorance is truly bliss in this case.
say:10:1441118009:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰所有人都一样，哪怕知道真相，也没有第二种选择，...

choice_prompt:11:1441118009.text: Everyone in Sal'thorin is the same—even though we know the truth, we don't have any other choice. Ignorance is truly bliss in this case.
choice_prompt:11:1441118009.source_cn: 萨洛克兰所有人都一样，哪怕知道真相，也没有第二种选择，只会增添清醒的痛苦。

say:12:1441118010:1.text: Once you've faced failure, you'll come to see that the rules you once opposed might not be so unreasonable after all.
say:12:1441118010:1.source_cn: 失败会让你们认识到，不认同的规则，不代表它不合理。

say:13:1441118011:1.text: I've failed before and paid a heavy price for it.
say:13:1441118011:1.source_cn: 迷途之人，我曾经犯过同样的错误，也付出过沉重的代价。

choice:11:1:2.text: You need the truth to be sure.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 知道真相才能确定选择是否唯一
choice:11:1:2.male: You need the truth to be sure.
choice:11:1:2.female: You need the truth to be sure.

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 被蒙蔽的过往不能代表任何东西
